comments.content: createDatabase(operatorUrl) 被放在内层 try 之外：addressOf 对若干能通过 config 加载（spreadOptional 仅透传字符串、不做 URL 校验）但地址非法的连接串会同步抛 TypeError——如密码含未编码 `%`、端口 `:0`、`sslmode=prefer/verify-ca`、`sslrootcert` 未配 `verify-full`、空库名等。该异常会穿透到外层 catch，使整个市场（含只读 GET /）降级为 createUnavailablePluginPackageRoutes，违背本段注释承诺的"无操作员通道时仍服务读接口、仅 plan/apply 503 ADMIN_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE"契约。对比同文件 7 处既有调用（1102、1213、1241、1279、1307、1328、1355 行）均将 createDatabase 一并包进 .catch(() => null)，同样故障只降级管理半边。另：外层日志统一记为 plugin-package-catalogue-unavailable，会把操作员通道故障误导为目录加载故障，不利排障。建议把 createDatabase 也纳入内层 try，并区分日志类型。

裸字符串错误与同一 PR 中建立的品牌化错误体系不一致：contracts.ts 专门提供了 PackageServiceError/packageErrorCodeOf（其注释还强调 isPackageStorageFailure "never by message text"），而本模块的 "INPUT_INVALID" 与 get() 中的 "RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND" 目前完全依赖 routes.ts errorCodeFor 的 message switch 精确匹配（已验证两侧当前一致、映射到 400/404），任何一侧未来拼写漂移都会静默退化为 500 INTERNAL。建议复用统一的错误构造（contracts.ts 未反向依赖本模块，catalogue → enterprise/plugin-packages/contracts 无循环），或在 shared 层定义共享错误类型。

Now I have all the information I need. Let me consolidate:

**Issue 5 (updatedAt):** In apply(), the install is INSERTed (new row, default now() applies). For PKG02, install-only operation — no UPDATE to installs happens in apply (existing → REVISION_CONFLICT). The only UPDATE is on plan rows (consume). Plans table has no updatedAt column (correct — it has createdAt, expiresAt, consumedAt). So the updated_at concern doesn't manifest in PKG02 code paths. The schema has updatedAt with default only — if a future PKG06 upgrade path forgets to set it, timestamps drift. That's speculative/future concern. The review plan's concern is not confirmed as an actual bug now. I'll drop issue 5 (no comment) — or optionally a low note. Given "avoid commenting on correct code," and no current write path omits it, I'll skip.

**Issue 4 (sequential buildRecord):** loadPackageCatalogue is called once at startup (index.ts line 1152, top-level await). Current index: 1 package. Schema allows up to 4096. Sequential is memory-safe (only one package's buffers in memory at a time — well, actually buildRecord → loadArtifact → buildArtifact holds ALL buffers for that one package; sequential means max 16 MiB extra at a time. Parallel Promise.all over 4096 entries would hold up to 64 GiB — catastrophic). So sequential is a deliberate memory-safety tradeoff. A bounded-concurrency pool would be the improvement. Severity: low, performance, with the note that unbounded Promise.all would be wrong. Worth a low comment.

**Issue 7 (bare string errors):** Functionally handled by routes.ts message switch (verified: `case "INPUT_INVALID"`, `case "RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND"`). But the catalogue module is in server/src/plugin-packages (a lower layer) while the PackageServiceError vocabulary lives in enterprise/plugin-packages/contracts. The bare-string coupling is fragile: a typo in either side silently degrades to 500 INTERNAL. Given routes.ts already matches these strings, it works today. I'll report as low-severity maintainability on catalogue.ts, suggesting reuse of packageError or exporting a shared error type from plugin-packages layer. Hmm, but wait — layering: catalogue.ts is server/src/plugin-packages, contracts.ts is server/src/enterprise/plugin-packages. enterprise layer imports plugin-packages (install-service imports catalogue). If catalogue imported packageError from enterprise/plugin-packages/contracts, that would create a cycle (enterprise/plugin-packages/* → plugin-packages/catalogue → enterprise/plugin-packages/contracts). contracts.ts itself imports from shared + tenancy only — no import of plugin-packages — so cycle would only form if contracts imported catalogue-adjacent modules. It doesn't. So catalogue → contracts import is acyclic. But architecturally, an alternative: move error codes to shared. Anyway, suggestion is valid. Low severity.

**Issue 9 (duplicate compareUtf8):** Confirmed identical implementations in artifact.ts (line ~56) and catalogue.ts (line ~113). Both in review_files. Low, maintainability. Comment on one (catalogue.ts) referencing artifact.ts, or on both? One comment suffices — attach to catalogue.ts's copy... Actually better attach to the second occurrence (catalogue.ts) since artifact.ts came first? Both are new files in this PR. I'll comment on catalogue.ts's definition.

Also catalogue.ts duplicates PACKAGE_KEY_PATTERN / PACKAGE_ID_PATTERN / version regex from shared/enterprise/plugin-package-contracts.ts (which exports PackageKeySchema, PackageIdSchema, PackageVersionSchema, and even the patterns are module-private there but schemas exported). resolveRelease hardcodes the version regex `^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$` instead of importing PackageVersionSchema.safeParse. Drift risk: if shared pattern changes, catalogue's copy silently diverges. This is a legit low maintainability finding — I can fold it into the same comment or a separate one on catalogue.ts. Let me include it as part of the duplication comment.

**Issue 11 (directory count limit):** walkPackage limits files (MAX_FILES 512) and total bytes, but directories unbounded. A malicious/corrupt artifact with e.g. 100k nested/empty directories → long walk, many lstat calls. Note: MAX_FILES applies to files; each directory adds a readdir + per-entry lstat. Since packages are built by trusted build script (scripts/plugin-packages/build.ts) and stored content-addressed... the walk runs on locally stored artifacts under plugins/.artifacts — trusted build outputs. Threat is low but DoS-on-startup via corrupted artifact store is plausible. Low severity comment on artifact.ts.

Documented in comment as intentional. Debatable design; the comment says "40 transaction rollback" class → storage. It's a deliberate, documented choice; mapping deadlocks to 503 (retryable) is actually semantically reasonable for clients. 57014 from statement_timeout — treating as storage unavailable is arguable.
